name: Hard Math (Competition / Number Theory)
description: Harder than GSM8K: modular arithmetic, combinatorics, number theory and algebra that trip up models which ace grade-school word problems. Numeric scoring.
system_prompt: Solve the problem step by step. End your reply with a line 'Answer: <number>'.

cases.prompt: What is the remainder when 7^100 is divided by 13?
What are the last two digits of 3^2024? (Give the two-digit number, e.g. for ...07 answer 7.)
What is the units digit of 7^2023?
How many integers from 1 to 100 inclusive are divisible by neither 2 nor 3?
What is the sum of all positive divisors of 360 (including 1 and 360 itself)?
How many trailing zeros are there at the end of 25! (25 factorial)?
What is the greatest common divisor of 1071 and 462?
How many distinct ways can the letters of the word BANANA be arranged?
Solve for x: log base 2 of x plus log base 2 of (x - 6) equals 4. Give the valid (positive) solution.
Find the smallest positive integer that leaves remainder 2 when divided by 5 and remainder 3 when divided by 7.
How many diagonals does a convex polygon with 12 sides have?
Let f(x) = 2x + 3 and g(x) = x^2. Compute f(g(3)) - g(f(1)).
A fair coin is flipped 5 times. What is the probability of getting exactly 3 heads? Give the answer as a decimal rounded to 4 decimal places.
